ddfefad507160a8d.column_purpose: Timestamp when the badge was awarded to the user. Range 2010-07-19 to 2014-09-14; the spike on 2014-07-02 (899 awards) suggests a bulk/migration award event.

676b04cebec76174.column_purpose: Primary key; unique identifier for this badge-award row.

2223551ed8ef62a4.column_purpose: Name of the badge awarded (e.g. Student, Supporter, Editor, Scholar, Teacher, Autobiographer). Some values look like topic tags (correlation, pca, modeling), suggesting participation-based badges named after tags.

712487879d124cf4.column_purpose: Foreign key to users.Id; the user who earned the badge. Many-to-one: users can earn many badges.

108df7baa66b181d.column_purpose: Timestamp when the comment was created. Range 2009-02-02 to 2014-09-14, consistent with the site's activity period.

730d70194a365507.column_purpose: Primary key of the comment; unique integer identifier.

775e51bd94ad6c0f.column_purpose: Foreign key to posts.Id — the question or answer the comment was posted on. Many comments per post.

fea0599042db3d9a.column_purpose: Upvote count of the comment (net score). Mostly 0 (77%), max 90.

ec1bcbc6e8a616b3.column_purpose: Body text of the comment. Contains @username replies, thanks, moderation notes — typical comment content.

809bb7fcbbcb074a.column_purpose: Display name of the comment author, populated only when the author's user account no longer exists (98.4% null; values like 'user10525' are anonymized deleted accounts, others are real names). Complements UserId.

74e8c70ac6cde555.column_purpose: Foreign key to users.Id — the comment author. Null (1.6%) when the account was deleted, in which case UserDisplayName is populated instead.

3683894515f37e0d.column_purpose: Editor/system comment describing the change, e.g. 'edited body', 'added 1 characters in body', 'removed signature and greetings'; empty for most events.

a71d630c721c758a.column_purpose: Timestamp when the history event/revision occurred.

933d60bb71bda2cd.column_purpose: Primary key of the post history event.

d38e7cfca7255e09.column_purpose: Code for the type of history event (Stack Exchange PostHistoryTypeId scheme: 1=initial title, 2=initial body, 3=initial tags, 4=edit title, 5=edit body, 6=edit tags, 10/11/12=closed/reopened/bounty, 33/35/36=hold/notice, etc.). No lookup table present, so exact mapping beyond the common low values is inferred from Stack Exchange conventions.

797e8c82dc6527b0.column_purpose: Foreign key to posts.Id, the post this history event applies to.

857a0b3334298e76.column_purpose: UUID grouping the history rows that belong to the same revision of a post (multiple rows share a GUID when title/body/tags changed together).

b30d8e8185804bf1.column_purpose: Content captured by the event: the post body/title text for edit events, tag names for tag events, or JSON (e.g. close voters) for moderation events.

7dd86aeefab103e9.column_purpose: Display name of the user who made the change, populated only when no UserId (e.g. deleted users); mostly empty.

42fb96c5a2943585.column_purpose: Foreign key to users.Id, the user who performed the event; -1 denotes the system/community user; null for some events.

7376812dfce0a0a6.column_purpose: Timestamp when the link between the two posts was created.

79547ab7f236a072.column_purpose: Primary key of the post link row; unique integer identifier.

218cbc1efd7e38a3.column_purpose: Type of link between the posts. Only two values occur: 1 (10186 rows) and 3 (916 rows). In the Stack Exchange schema these mean 1 = 'Linked' (related post) and 3 = 'Duplicate' (post marked as duplicate of another). The exact code meanings are inferred from the standard schema, not from a lookup table in this database.

f52d304a9849880a.column_purpose: Id of the post from which the link originates; references posts.Id (many links can point from one post).

ab1c7359b481a818.column_purpose: Id of the post being linked to (the related or duplicate target); references posts.Id.

89f13eff3f237703.column_purpose: Id of the answer post accepted as the best answer by the question's asker; null for answers and unanswered questions. References posts.Id (self-join).

ee8ee9d1a4370077.column_purpose: Number of answers received by a question; null for non-question posts.

eff802d5da49d86f.column_purpose: HTML-rendered body text of the post (question or answer content).

810025b9b0128733.column_purpose: Timestamp when the question was closed (no longer accepting answers); null for open questions and non-question posts.

be484cddf5889595.column_purpose: Number of comments on the post.

ff4f0987a3aac4f1.column_purpose: Timestamp when the post became community wiki (ownership/reputation transferred to the community); null otherwise.

1613d9dfb5a8215e.column_purpose: Timestamp when the post was created (typo in column name).

8de7f484bb3cc72e.column_purpose: Number of users who favorited/starred the question; null for non-question posts.

fc688645692907c0.column_purpose: Primary key of the post; referenced by comments, votes, postHistory, postLinks, and tags.

784d1036f2fbaacb.column_purpose: Timestamp of the most recent activity on the post (edits, answers, comments); typo in column name.

1c019e9bfae90e65.column_purpose: Timestamp of the most recent edit; null if never edited.

b8528e64b75be1f7.column_purpose: Display name of the last editor when the editor's user account is unavailable (e.g. deleted user, shown as 'userNNN'); mostly null.

7f646a620a27c141.column_purpose: Id of the user who last edited the post; -1 denotes a system/community user; null if never edited. References users.Id.

66d84f66c46a88c7.column_purpose: Display name of the post owner when the owner's user account is unavailable; mostly null.

fcd52aefd02bd1b8.column_purpose: Id of the user who owns (created) the post; -1 denotes a system/community user. References users.Id.

d25abc37f26eeb39.column_purpose: Id of the question post this post is an answer to; null for questions and other top-level posts. Self-reference to posts.Id.

3a080fa91a4cbfd3.column_purpose: Type of post: 1=question, 2=answer; values 4 and 5 likely tag wiki excerpt and tag wiki, 6/7 moderator nomination and wiki placeholder (low counts, exact meanings unresolved).

6524c244e60d3ccf.column_purpose: Net vote score of the post (upvotes minus downvotes; can be negative).

bd0b3448625d5a68.column_purpose: Angle-bracket-delimited tag labels attached to a question (e.g. <regression><r>); null for answers.

0860360edf01cc09.column_purpose: Title of the question; null for answers.

e416d8d55ef20bcf.column_purpose: Number of times the question's page has been viewed; null for answers.

8a7d6cc2b0993d1d.column_purpose: Number of posts using this tag (usage count). Minimum 1, max 7244, heavily right-skewed.

aa055b6e74208ba6.column_purpose: Id of the post (posts.Id) containing the tag's short usage excerpt. Null for ~42% of tags that have no excerpt.

7241c75a6a935153.column_purpose: Id of the post (posts.Id) containing the tag's full wiki description. Null when no wiki exists; typically one less than ExcerptPostId.

d01a58c401352ad6.column_purpose: User-written 'about me' profile bio, stored as HTML. Often empty or placeholder ('please delete me', 'merge keep' suggest account deletions/merges).

4cfbd7a02ee27e3a.column_purpose: Global network-wide account identifier (Stack Exchange network account id), unique per row; -1 is the anonymous/system placeholder account.

eefe79350088f3a0.column_purpose: Self-reported age in years (13-94, median 30). Mostly null because most users don't provide it.

539d3af5d8e3d702.column_purpose: Timestamp when the user account was created.

c751a4a83dd5b942.column_purpose: Public display name of the user; not unique (common first names repeat). Values like 'user34964' are auto-generated names for anonymous/deleted accounts.

b354a4297289ea60.column_purpose: Count of downvotes cast by this user (denormalized counter; most users have 0).

185d1acde42061c4.column_purpose: Primary key: site-local user id. Referenced by posts.OwnerUserId, posts.LastEditorUserId, comments.UserId, badges.UserId, postHistory.UserId. Id -1 is the community/anonymous placeholder.

8ab1310eb67c7d9a.column_purpose: Timestamp of the user's most recent site access/login.

ed2b2361552a261c.column_purpose: Self-reported free-text location (city/country), e.g. 'London, United Kingdom'.

054cca9e9643aba0.column_purpose: URL of the user's avatar image (gravatar, googleusercontent, facebook graph). The most common value is the default identicon gravatar.

d1c101b9f8d3d438.column_purpose: User's reputation score on the site (Stack Exchange-style points earned via votes and accepted answers); min 1, max 87393.

a783c861fa5d6e93.column_purpose: Count of upvotes cast by this user (denormalized counter; most users have 0).

4f26349a6b2a61e6.column_purpose: Number of times the user's profile page has been viewed (denormalized counter).

c7bfa23e7ed70ec0.column_purpose: Personal website URL from the user's profile; placeholder values like 'http://none', 'http://N/A' are common.

ff9767b9c8629a42.column_purpose: Reputation amount of the bounty attached to this vote, in whole points. Populated only for bounty-related votes (VoteTypeId 8 bounty start / 9 bounty close); null for all other vote types, hence the ~99.7% null rate. Values are typical bounty sizes (25, 50, 100, 150, 200; 0 appears for bounty-close votes where the amount was already awarded).

7e6699c350ec0400.column_purpose: Date the vote was cast (day granularity, no time component). Range 2010-07-19 to 2011-05-01, consistent with the site's activity period.

20b3efbf727a0f03.column_purpose: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for the vote row.

5fb9f6cc4581febd.column_purpose: Foreign key to posts.Id: the post the vote was cast on. Many votes per post.

709cc472eafa758c.column_purpose: Id of the user who cast the vote (references users.Id, though the join was not auto-detected). Null for anonymous vote types (up/down/accept, VoteTypeId 1-3), which are the vast majority; populated for user-attributed votes such as favorites and bounty starts/closes.

529168fa206dd396.column_purpose: Coded vote type (StackExchange vote types): 1 = accepted answer, 2 = upvote (dominant, ~85%), 3 = downvote, 5 = favorite, 8 = bounty start, 9 = bounty close, 10 = deletion, 12 = spam flag, 15 = moderation, 16 = edit approved. No lookup table present, so the exact code-to-label mapping is inferred from the standard StackExchange schema rather than from data in this database.
